faqs.a:
Section 405.1.1. Unions,
is hereby added to read as follows:
"
405.1.1. Unions.
Unions or an approved means of disconnect shall be installed in the water supply
                  piping within 12 inches (305 mm) and on each side of the regulating equipment, water
                  heating, conditioning tanks, and similar equipment which may require service by removal
                  or replacement."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 11, 9-14-2020)
